categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in the power electronics industry, focusing on three main sectors: new energy vehicles (including charging and swapping station power supplies and thermal management power supplies), smart grid (including power operation power supplies, distribution automation terminal power management modules, UPS/inverter power supplies, and HVDC products for data centers), and aerospace (customized aerospace power supplies and testing services).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes resonant voltage-controlled power converter technology (LLC) for high-efficiency, high-density, and reliable power conversion. It employs advanced manufacturing processes including automated SMT lines, automated assembly, and comprehensive testing systems. The company emphasizes modular design, soft-switching technology, and uses silicon carbide (SiC) devices to enhance product performance and reduce costs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include national and regional power grid companies (State Grid, Southern Grid), new energy vehicle manufacturers and charging infrastructure operators, aerospace equipment manufacturers, and data center operators. The company serves industries such as new energy vehicles, smart grids, aerospace, metallurgy, petrochemicals, and transportation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant market presence in Northern, Eastern, Southern, and Western China regions. It also actively expands overseas markets, participating in international exhibitions and establishing offices in multiple countries to broaden its global footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, and manufacturing of power electronic modules and systems that serve as core components for downstream applications in charging stations, smart grids, and aerospace equipment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in power conversion technologies, product iteration, and intelligent upgrades. The company invests heavily in R&D to develop high-performance charging modules, thermal management power supplies, and smart grid power systems, including HVDC products. It also emphasizes expanding product portfolios to cover emerging market needs such as V2G and integrated thermal management solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of power electronic products and customized power supply solutions. The company employs a direct sales model, securing orders via bidding and negotiations, and provides after-sales services. It also derives income from government subsidies and related service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's power electronics sector, especially in charging modules for new energy vehicles and smart grid power supplies. It holds a strong market share domestically and is recognized for technological leadership and product reliability. Competitors include other domestic and international power electronics manufacturers, but the company maintains competitive advantages through innovation and comprehensive product offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.21 billion, representing a 19.89% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 23.94 million, reflecting a decline due to increased R&D and marketing expenses. The company has shown steady revenue growth with expanding market penetration, supported by increased R&D investment (9.37% of revenue) and enhanced operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high reliability, high efficiency, and high power density in its products, leveraging proprietary resonant soft-switching technology and advanced materials like SiC. Its products are designed for diverse and harsh environments with features such as liquid cooling, high protection levels (IP65), low noise, and wide temperature adaptability. The company also offers customized solutions and comprehensive after-sales support, aiming to be a global leader in power electronics for new energy vehicles, smart grids, and aerospace.
